svg.text: VulcaTrack: Sales and Inventory with On-the-Go Services
Customer Details (optional link to a registered customer)
D1 customers D2 admins D3 vehicles D4 items
D5 sales (with sale_items line detail) D6 service_requests D7 tiremen
Customer – submits OTG service requests; manages own profile and vehicles.
Admin – runs the shop: POS, inventory, customers, and OTG request handling.
Tireman – performs the OTG service; a record in D7 assigned by the Admin, not a
system user (no Tireman login or dashboard).
• OTG requires an authenticated customer, a saved vehicle, and a shared location
(latitude / longitude). The ETA is calculated once when the request is created
and stored as a frozen snapshot – it is never recalculated.
• No live GPS tracking and no route geometry is stored. Request statuses are
• POS: online / GCash payment is out of scope. Walk-in sales need no customer
account. Product sale lines deduct D4 stock; service lines do not.
• Deactivation (is_active = 0) replaces hard delete for D3, D4 and D7.
